style: 3D animation, original character design, vivid saturated colors, high contrast
opening: the video opens mid-arc: ONE heavy brown bear in a mustard cardigan is already dangling head-down from his left ankle, arcing like a pendulum on her rope running out of the top of the frame, his gold key in his teeth, his upside-down face rushing into the lens and whipping past
subject: exactly one bear and one fox, no other animals
second_characters: ONE ginger fox, the bank, emerald vest, silent
props: her rope with a loop; her plain red tag on his left ankle; her red stamp; his gold key; his honey jar; her straw; his pillow; his stump
environment: 0.00-0.80: open sunlit turquoise air behind him, nothing behind him, no wall, no floor. From 0.80 only, after he falls: his den, his round red door glowing with daylight, her key board, moss floor, teal clay walls, moss bed by a stump
lighting: warm sunbeam on his muzzle always; rim: turquoise from walls, gold daylight from his door
motion_rule: he fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.sfx: 0.15 pendulum whoosh; 0.55 stamp slap; 1.0 flop into moss; 4.0 slap, oof; 5.4 head thud on stump; 6.9 jar slap; 7.7 LOUDEST slurp; 8.5 belly thud; 9.4 key clink; 9.8 rope jerk, whoosh

timeline.a: close-up: mid-arc, his face with his key in his teeth rushes into the lens and past; on the way back her stamp pops up from below and slaps his tag
timeline.c: whip up from below, his face at the lens

timeline.a: her paw tugs the knot, her rope slips off his ankle; he lands head-first in his den by his round red door, his key flies from his teeth into his paws; his mouth free, moving
he sprawls on the moss and, mouth moving, thrusts his key in his paws at the lens
timeline.c: skims low over the moss to his key at the lens

timeline.a: he, mouth moving, tucks his key into his cardigan pocket; she climbs his back onto his head
timeline.c: rises over her shoulder on his head

timeline.a: he, mouth moving; close-up: her stamp slams his belly, red print, his belly flies into the lens
timeline.c: drops down his front to his belly

timeline.a: he, mouth moving, flops on his back onto his pillow
close-up: she yanks his pillow into the lens, his head knocks his stump
timeline.c: slides low past his stump, his pillow across the lens

timeline.a: he, mouth moving, on his back, slaps his honey jar onto his belly, hugging it; her straw comes down into his jar
timeline.c: plunges straight down to his jar

timeline.a: peak, close-up: her straw drains his honey in one gulp, his jar jerks up out of his paws, he lurches after it nose-first into the lens
timeline.c: the camera hurls itself down along her straw to his nose

timeline.a: he crashes belly-down at the lens, both his paws empty; she holds his empty jar and drops his pocketed key into his paws
timeline.c: sinks low to his empty paws, her tail across the lens

timeline.a: close-up: he grips his key in his teeth; her loop yanks his left ankle up, he whips head-down into the first pendulum arc, face rushing at the lens
timeline.c: whips up with him, low from below, as at 0.00

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, drawn-out delivery, static camera, locked-off shots, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, second bear, two bears, extra fox, humans, logos, letters or numbers on objects, widescreen
